queryLines:
SELECT
    make_date(year, month, day) AS trip_date,
    taxi_type,
    coalesce(pickup_borough, 'Unknown') AS pickup_borough,
    coalesce(pickup_zone, 'Unknown') AS pickup_zone,
    coalesce(dropoff_borough, 'Unknown') AS dropoff_borough,
    coalesce(dropoff_zone, 'Unknown') AS dropoff_zone,
    concat(
        coalesce(pickup_zone, 'Unknown'), ' → ',
        coalesce(dropoff_zone, 'Unknown')
    ) AS route,
    trip_count,
    total_revenue,
    total_tips,
    avg_trip_distance,
    avg_trip_duration_minutes,
    total_trip_distance,
    credit_card_trip_count,
    cash_trip_count,
    credit_card_fare_total,
    credit_card_tip_total
FROM dbw_dev_northeurope_bfn0.default.daily_route_metrics
